- Signed bank letter (on bank letterhead) or an ACH verification from the bank (PDF)
- Voided check (PDF) OR bank verification document showing the routing/account
- Updated W-9 (PDF) with the exact legal name you want on the vendor record

Please send the attachments when ready and include Luis on subsequent replies. If you prefer, we can run a quick 15-minute verification call Monday morning to walk through the docs.
